exposure: Admission in latent phase of labor
Admission in active phase of labor
finding: Pregnant women admitted in the latent phase of labor at a hospital in Tanzania experience significantly more obstetric interventions, including augmentation with oxytocin, artificial rupture of membranes, and cesarean sections, compared to those admitted during the active phase.
mod_finding: Cesarean section rates were significantly higher in the latent phase group than the active phase group (34.8% vs 24.0%, p < 0.05).
